16 Years of Heartfelt Baking Craft

Our Story & Heritage

16 Years of Baking for Life's Special Moments

Behind Hamtunes Cakes & Bakes is a dedicated baker with 16 years of experience creating cakes and baked treats for diverse occasions. What started with a deep passion for the craft has grown into a trusted destination for milestone birthdays, heartfelt gifts, family gatherings, and festive celebrations.

Every cake is customized to your taste, theme, and occasion. At the same time, our fresh doughnuts, cupcakes, meat pies, and authentic small chops bring warmth and flavor to any event or tea break.

Real authentic bakery photography
Equal focus on cakes and baked treats
Direct consultation with the baker
Catering for families, gifts, and events
